presetNotes:
Since arch glacor is a fairly random fight, with each fight giving completely attack rotations, I will not be giving a ability by ability guide. I will instead be giving general advice and what you want each attack to look like.

Switch to spirit shield right before being hit by attacks for 30% and less damage. Use melee for general DPS, range when out of range, for ammo effects like bik and more general survivability with masterwork. Since arch glacor is poisonable and is a rather long fight we will have ample time to build up bik arrow stacks, this combined with cinderbane and things like armour spikes, recoil, bleeds, and most interestingly splintering arrows allows for a lot of damage coming from poison, poison which is also boosted by equilibrium.

Remember to prepot overload, kwuarm and lantadyme inceanse sticks, and powder of penance and protection. On a dummy in wars retreat use a dragon baxe spec then get back to full adren. Remember to store a master magic cape on the skillcape rack for double the time of vulnerability, and more importantly enfeeble with IotH will have 100% uptime.

For cannon deactive prayer, use vengeance, repriasal, vit burst, reflect, freedom and for the final hit use resonance, with this method you will heal most of the damage you receive, while also recoiling up to 60k damage. If wanting to be safer or if you get a back to back cannon instead use anticipate, debilitate or reflect or even shield dome if it is at 50% block, then use deflect mage for the first 2 hits, for the third use resonance, if resonance is on cooldown use preparation for the first 2 hits which should bring resonance of cooldown.

For flury it is recommended use pulverize so we don't take to much damage, make sure enfeeble is active. Try to use either debilitate or reflect, shield dome may also be used, even if it is at 25%. With EoF and spirit shield flicks this is not strictly necessary. If hp is a major problem disruption shield can help tank some damage. If you feel you have enough time before cannons and it's off cooldown you can use a resonance or if hp is fine divert, after doing either be sure to use preparation to make sure it is ready for cannon.

For minions use debiliate on bolstered glacyte, or shield dome which will block all damage not just the bolstered but will scale its defense down, minions can be done with 25% dome but 50% is much safer. You want to do this since we will be both taking more damage and be unable to easily spirit shield and EoF flick. Can elect to camp EoF for melee since we will be using tumekens light, therefore making am-hej less important. If it is off cooldown and think it will be off cooldown before cannon or you feel safer debilitating cannon, you can elect to use a reflect.

For range minions use decimation spec, Deadshot, SGB if off cooldown, then spam gloomfire spec. You should have effectively infinite adren with imbue shadow, if you do however run out of adren, use gricho with crossbow + hydrix bakriminel bolts for amazing adren regain.

For melee minions you should already have built some bloodlust stacks knowing it could be minions, equip tumekens light use its spec then use adaptive to get adren back and a bloodlust stack then hurricane, as long as it hits all minions plus ag and you had 4 bloodlust it should completely reset the cooldown therefore allowing us to use a second cane. After this use rend, adaptive then chaos roar to get back up to 4 stacks, in this time cane will come off cooldown allowing use to use another cane into cane immediately.

For arms I don't have an exact rotation. It will look fairly similar to minions, you can also just improvise with strong damaging attacks, I would say as far and damaging attacks go, arms is on the highest priority, meaning no attack is to precious for arms. If ranging you won't have a chance to build up things like bik or splintering, and you should already have things like death swiftness active, therefore you should just camp ful arrows. For melee you should not use ezk as it kinda sucks without flamebound rival, and using flame bound rival on arms is a atrocious idea, it not only clears as soon as you kill but also clears it from ag and uses the full cooldown.

Surprisingly we rarely need devotion, with powder of protection EoF passive and spirit shield flicks we are taking fairly low damage from auto attacks, and we will usually be clearing arms before it is needed, however it is recommended to still save it, using it only when life or death, it is better to try to recoil damage and deal it back then it is to not take the damage.

Berserk is a rather risky skill to use for AG, it cannot be used for cannon or else you take way to much damage. For arms and minions if you don't get a proper fast clear then you will take a lot of damage, and you will probably get a slow clear if you are trying to use berserk reactionary, as you will have very little adren to start, so it is really only safe if you have already gotten cannon and can use it while still getting your adren back before the attack. It is very safe to use during beams but you won't be able to take full effect of it with beams do to you being out of attack range during it. For flurry you can use it relatively safely thanks to things like EoF passive flicks and flamebound rival make you take a minumal amount of damage.

Split soul (ECB spec) is a bit safer to use then berserk but still rather risky, since it removes healing from soul split rather then increasing all damage it can be used at a few more places safely. At cannon it is completely safe as long as you are doing a defensive rotation that leaves you with high enough hp for a few autos. At minions it is risky but can be used, even with the lack of healing, simply dealing so much extra damage allows you to kill the minions so fast that they barely do any damage. For arms it is fairly safe as you only want to use soul split at the start of arms, later on you prayer reflect mage, and at that start of arms you take so little damage that it does not really matter. It is incredibly good for beams, as you take no damage and unlike melee beams where you cannot attack for parts of it, range beams let you attack at almost any point. Flurry is about the same as berserk, won't let you veng unless you can also resonance, other then that it's fine to use.

Try to keep up on all enemies at all times

2h weapons

Rarely used, mainly for the spec, flurry and other duel wield abilities

Free lossless healing

Equilibrium 4 crystal shield 1 + crackling 4 relentless 5
Decimation spec, use for minions
Impatient 4 devoted 4 + ultimatums 4 mobile

Seren godbow spec, very powerful AoE when used with decimation spec
